errors.evidence: The blue line representing outflows is at approximately 7% in 2020, not 6.3%. The value 6.3% corresponds to the dashed blue line, which is the average.
The blue line decreases from 2020 to 2021, going from approx. 7% to approx. 5.5%. The description incorrectly states that it rises to 9.0%.
The description states the blue line 'sinkt' (decreases) to 8.0% in 2022. However, the line actually rises from approx. 5.5% in 2021 to approx. 8.5% in 2022.
The value for the blue line in 2023 is approximately 6%, not 5.0%.
The purple line starts at approximately 4.5% in 2005, not 3.5%.
The value for the purple line in 2014 is negative, at approximately -0.5%. The description states a positive value of 0.5%.
The value for the purple line in 2020 reaches its peak at approximately 6.5%, not 5.0%.

errors.text_span: Eine durchgezogene lila Linie stellt den Anteil Deutschlands an weltweiten Zuflüssen dar, der von 3,5 % im Jahr 2005 auf 1,0 % im Jahr 2008 fällt, 2010 auf 3,0 % ansteigt, 2013 auf 2,0 % sinkt, 2014 auf 0,5 % fällt, 2015 auf 1,0 % steigt, 2018 auf 2,5 % ansteigt, 2020 auf 5,0 % steigt, 2021 auf 3,0 % sinkt, 2022 auf 2,0 % fällt, 2023 auf 1,5 % und 2024 auf 1,0 % abnimmt.
errors.evidence: The description attempts to list the value of the purple line for 11 different years. This level of detail is excessive for a summary and, in this case, leads to a high number of factual errors as most of the reported values are incorrect.
